decisions.reason: After several years, management can still attribute any uneven demand to temporary workplace-market shifts, and the multi-model desk system's visible investment and strong fit with flexible office interiors support continued commitment.

The chair family remains close to the firm's core offer and benefits from prior design and marketing investment, so management is likely to justify staying with it rather than admit an unsuccessful launch.

The high standing table is somewhat more exposed to changing office-use patterns, but its proximity to the established range and the sunk effort behind its launch still make persistence more likely than withdrawal.

Even though rugs are more distant from the traditional assortment, the collection was publicly framed as a flagship direction, which strongly encourages escalation of commitment and continued backing.
